lines.text: Build a shape so its corner at the yellow dot is 45 degrees. You can use more than one piece. Then tap Check.
Fill the shadow to build a castle. Drag pieces. Tap a piece to turn it.
Fill the shadow to build a lighthouse. Drag pieces. Tap a piece to turn it.
Fill the shadow to build a zoo. Drag pieces. Tap a piece to turn it.
How many squares cover this block?
Look at the grey shape. Build the same shape turned a half turn, so it is upside down, inside the yellow box. Drag pieces. Tap a piece to turn it. Tap Flip to flip it.
Look for a piece that does not fit yet. Move it out and try another spot.
Put the small triangle so its square corner, the right angle, is at (4,1). Count across first, then up. Then tap Check.
That is one answer. Tap Check.
This right triangle has legs 4 and 3. How long is the long side, the hypotenuse? Type it and tap OK.
This shadow is a tent, turned around. Fill it with all seven pieces. Drag pieces. Tap a piece to turn it. Tap Flip to flip it.
